children.title: Store & Model: Pass infra bounce reasons through release and store on WorkItem
children.intent: Update WorkItem model and Board::release to record explicit failure/bounce reasons in history and store on WorkItem.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked passes; store test verifies calling release_with_reason records the bounce reason on WorkItem and transition history.

children.title: Supervisor: Capture and forward human-readable error messages on infrastructure failure
children.intent: Update supervisor Fleet::supervise so that when is_infrastructure or sandbox creation fails, the human-readable error string is passed to release.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked passes; supervisor tests verify that infrastructure failure messages are passed to board release.

children.title: API & Web UI: Expose bounce reasons in API and render in card drawer
children.intent: Expose last_bounce_reason in API responses and render the human-readable bounce reason in the card detail drawer and overview.
children.definition_of_done: cargo test --offline --locked and cargo clippy --offline -- -D warnings pass; card drawer renders the bounce reason when present on WorkItem.
